prompt: Create one polished technical overview illustration, landscape 1800x1300 or similar, white background, fine rounded outlines, restrained pastel blue purple orange and green panels, generous whitespace, large legible sans-serif English labels. Orange row heading "Calibrated stereo". Left shows two parallel cameras and thumbnail pair, middle box "Rectify + FoundationStereo", right box "Disparity + known baseline -> depth". Left shows three small overlapping views of the same table and cube, middle box "VGGT / DA3 / MapAnything", right shows tiny camera frustums around point cloud labeled "Cameras + depth + 3D points". Green row heading "Video over time". Left shows three chronological thumbnails labeled "t0", "t1", "t2", middle area shows TWO vertically stacked INDEPENDENT boxes and arrows: top box "SLAM" leads to "Camera trajectory + map"; bottom box "CoTracker3" leads to "2D point tracks". processing: RGB WebP quality=88, method=6, original dimensions
review: Checked tool and output labels and arrows; four separate routes, SLAM and CoTracker3 remain separate.
